name: Update Review
author: jampick
description: Shows exactly which packages an update would change, and what it will ask for afterwards, before you start it. Can also flag new posts on omarchy.org/news.

barWidget.description: Appears when Omarchy is behind, or when omarchy.org has posted news and news alerts are on. Left click reviews every pending package with versions, download size, and whether a reboot follows, filterable by name. Right click updates straight away.

schema.label: Check interval (hours)
schema.description: How often to ask whether Omarchy is behind. The pending-package detail is read from the same sync, so a shorter interval costs no extra network.

schema.label: Re-read on open after (minutes)
schema.description: Opening the panel shows the cached list immediately. It only re-reads the mirrors if the cache is older than this.

schema.label: News alerts
schema.description: When On, a newspaper icon appears for unread posts on omarchy.org/news. The feed is checked on the same interval as updates, with an ETag, so a check that finds nothing new downloads nothing.
